# KI: MIMO 6D Dynamic Control Surface for Multi-Objective Agentic Harnesses

## Operational Summary
Autonomous agents execute diverse tasks (code generation, long-horizon repair, factual retrieval, security analysis) that require conflicting runtime constraints. Hardcoding a static context window, timeout, or temperature degrades agent performance. A 6-Dimensional MIMO harness tuple (D1: Context Max Triplets, D2: Tool Timeout & Circuit Breaker, D3: Decoding Temperature, D4: Routing Mode Policy, D5: Cross-Call Persistence, D6: Schema / AST Enforcement) dynamically synthesized per task type ensures optimal balance between creativity, strictness, and latency.
